      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _BGS Jason_, Sep 18, 2026, 1/5: "This app used to be functional. Whenever the major UI update rolled out, it’s been riddled with bugs. Whatever you guys did made this app borderline unusable. I assume the technology was offshored and that’s why it turned into what it is now"
            2. _AverageMean_, Sep 13, 2026, 1/5: "used to love the app but its filled with bugs (apps not blocking or blocking in loops when unblocked, spamming notifications…) since the 4.x update :( is there any way to get the old app back?"
            3. _lupercaia_, Aug 25, 2026, 1/5: "i really loved it first, but then the app started working worse and worse. first, some blocks that i set up started duplicating - meaning you had to unblock it twice. then some blocks started showing up on wrong times - like block that’s scheduled for weekdays on Saturday. Then unblocking the blocks became very easy and short for whatever reason?? My final straw was just now when I received the very same push notification frim them TEN TIMES IN A ROW. It used to be a great app, but it’s broken now."
